entries.reason: ENQ RESOURCE(NCS-ACC-NO-NAME) LENGTH(16) carries no NOSUSPEND, so a held resource suspends the task instead of returning ENQBUSY (the model refuses a planned-busy ENQ without NOSUSPEND), and the 16-byte length equals the name's size, so LENGERR and INVREQ are not raised either: RESP is always NORMAL.
DEQ RESOURCE(NCS-ACC-NO-NAME) LENGTH(16) follows the ENQ of the same 16-byte name in the same task, so the resource is held and the length matches: the DEQ always completes NORMAL.
WS-ORIG-DATE-MM is the month of the task's own date (FORMATTIME DDMMYYYY), always 01-12, and the WHENs list every month 1-12 (1,3,5,7,8,10,12 / 9,4,6,11 / 2): no month matches none.
